items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: So we got along. Told her, 'Don't be Miss Ann on us now. We're all here scuffling together.'

ctx.x: Yeah. Then she got so that -- I'd call a song, and she'd -- I don't want to sing that." So one night I had to read the riot act on her, and put her in her
place. You have to do that once in a while, you know. So we got along. Told her, 'Don't be Miss Ann on us now. We're all here scuffling together.'
But that was back in '38. Benny Goodman came through here -- was it '38 or '39?
